title: Florida House, District 74
what_it_does: Represents District 74 (Part of Sarasota) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Nick Pachota
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Mayor of Venice; paramedic/firefighter; co-owner, Venice Pier Group restaurants
candidates.background: Mayor of Venice and a career EMT, paramedic, firefighter and SWAT medic who co-owns the Venice Pier Group, including Sharky's on the Pier, and teaches in Sarasota County Public Schools' EMS program. A Cardinal Mooney High School graduate, he is married with two grown daughters. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

taxes.summary: His website pledges to cut taxes and add accountability measures so tax dollars are used conservatively.

candidates.name: Ryan Neill
candidates.background: Sarasota native and University of South Florida graduate who has worked for Publix Super Markets for more than 30 years. He says he is not a politician and has worked since age 16. Unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

housing.summary: In a local candidate questionnaire, Neill said housing affordability is the most important issue facing Florida and that as a homeowner outside politics he would bring fresh ideas to tackling the housing affordability crisis. He did not specify which policies he would pursue.
housing.quote: Housing affordability is the most important issue facing Florida today.

sources.title: Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Florida State District 74

environment.summary: In his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Neill listed funding for flood control and mitigation as one of his three key campaign messages, and said he is personally passionate about investment in mass transit. He did not say how he would weigh those against development.
environment.quote: Funding for flood control and mitigation.

sources.title: Ryan Neill - Ballotpedia (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

other_issues.title: Cost of living and wages
other_issues.summary: Neill says he is running because Tallahassee has ignored working-class families, rising costs and wage stagnation, and notes he has worked since he was 16 and is not a politician.

sources.title: Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Florida State District 74
